message:
fix(capture-lifecycle r3): a failed restart keeps its owner; GDI frames carry their attachment; an ended Serve's requests die with it; the status answer is one snapshot

Codex source recheck of 6fa709a (codex_capture_lifecycle_src_r2.md), residuals N1-a / N1-b / N2-end / N3-host.

N1-a  A real restart can fail after DetachCaptureSession (which stamps the current desktop generation), so
      "stale" vanished and the generic retry (8 s backoff, unbounded) took over. restart_capture_session now
      takes an owner (General / DesktopRebuild / FullFrame) kept with a failure (CaptureState::restartOwner):
      the rebuild stays open while this generation's rebuild failed and nothing attached since, 3 attempts per
      (generation, session), never ahead of the wrapper's own backoff; the generic retry leaves DesktopRebuild
      failures alone and retries FullFrame ones as that episode's own (no new source). No full-frame ask while
      a restart is pending.
N1-b  GDI frames carry their attachment cookie; PublishFrame refuses cookie 0. Every cache invalidation moves
      a continuity token the frame carries from when it was taken -- a readback submitted before an Unknown
      look completes after it: encoded, never cached.
N2    Each Serve() has its own sequence; a real end names (epoch, sequence). An ended Serve's requests --
      queued or late -- are dropped; a LATER Serve of the same epoch is live.
N3    Owner epoch, packed status, change count and handled key are published and read as one snapshot
      (host_backend_status_board.hpp); another owner's snapshot answers nothing for this session.
M9    Deterministic contrast: test-build StillPointerFirst hands one pointer-only acquire per open request.

Tests: UA --rebuild-fails rewritten on GNLINK_STREAM_TEST_FAIL_RESTART_FILE (fails after the detach; the r2
pre-call seam GNLINK_STREAM_TEST_DESKTOP_REBUILD_FAIL is gone), PS --still-pointerfirst, owner unit (end /
late post / later Serve), status board unit (new), capture_attachment [D] inverted (cookie 0 refused), [E][F]
held completions.

Product / test / docs: product (restart owner, rebuild rule, GDI cookie, continuity token, Serve sequence,
status board; lib test-only seam) / test (UA, PS, units) / docs (history).
